title: Leading-coordinate product on a prefixed input
statement: Let $g:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $b\in\{−1,1\}$, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube formed by multiplying the first coordinate by $g$ of the remaining coordinates, evaluated at the input with first coordinate $b$ and remaining coordinates $x$, equals $b g(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$x$ is an input in the sign cube
